payload.about: What AINexus is meant to be, in Kody's own words, and the rules every mind that works on it holds its work to: the assistant in any session on this repo, and the heartbeat's world mind on every tick. Read the newest frame of this stream before changing the world, the views line, the minds, the routines, the playout, or anything that seals a frame.

payload.amend: Only a successor frame on this stream changes the design, made with tools/intent.py amend. It says what changed and quotes the words of Kody's that changed it. When his words and a plan disagree, his words win: ask him, then record the answer here.

standing.rule: Build from rapp/1 primitives first; never build a parallel system and make it rapp/1 compliant afterward.
said: how can we utilize rapp/1 to do what we need in this application not how do we make this applicaiton rapp/1 compliant after the fact

standing.rule: Speed and simplicity are the product. Measure them, and refuse bloat.
said: this perf and simplicity IS the product over time.

standing.rule: Build bounded semantic controls, so the assistant can operate and play the world itself, through the same hands.
said: this way YOU can play this game too if you wanted... thats the end goal

standing.rule: Never modify the RAPP Brainstem Grail; use it only as it is.
said: no new runtime, no Grail changes

never.rule: Never give bodies in one place different clocks.
never.because: on 2026-09-25 the four bodies in the hub were given Tokyo, New York, London and Sydney clocks, so two slept in bed while two walked past them

never.rule: Never make the world's motion wait on a seat, a device code or an approval.
never.because: five Copilot device codes expired unapproved, and the bodies stood still for a day

never.rule: Never make a model per body the architecture.
never.because: four seats and four bills bought four minds that never shared a scene; one author makes one world

never.rule: Never publish a GODD input, or any transcript that saw one.
never.because: a thought's evidence is published whole, so a prompt that carried private data would publish it

never.rule: Never snap a body to a new frame.
never.because: a viewer that jumps shows two worlds; a body that walks to its twin shows one

never.rule: Never settle an ambiguous instruction by a guess and build on it; ask, or hold to the literal words, and record the answer here.
never.because: 'by timezone to make it universal' was read as a clock per body and shipped in PR #7

plan.what: One clock per place. The hub keeps New York time, where its heartbeat and its owner are. It is sealed once per frame, players carry no clock of their own, and a body sealed asleep under an old clock wakes when the place's clock says day.

The heartbeat wakes the assistant headless (copilot -p on the Mac mini, already signed in: no device code, and gpt-5-mini costs no premium requests) as the world's one mind. It is given this charter, the state played forward to now, and what was said, and it returns one directive for every body: act (fine manual control at this tick), say, and routine. The directive is validated and sealed as a rapp/1 frame on mind:@kody-w/ainexus, anchored to the spine tick and naming the charter frame that governed it. When no model answers, rules write it. A headless call from launchd answered in 10 s on 2026-09-25.

Each mind frame names the DOGG frames it took in, by hash: world:@kody-w/dogg (space weather, the ISS, earthquakes, markets, Hacker News, grid carbon) and dimensions such as sky, land, water and radio. Rules turn them into the world's sky, weather and talk, so it answers the network even when no model runs.

The mind may read this machine's GODD ledgers (godd/0-ledger). The published mind frame carries only HMAC commitments to them, the transcript that saw them is kept in the heartbeat's own GODD ledger, and a leak guard refuses any public output that quotes a private input.
Poses are computed, not measured: a views frame's state is the playout of the previous state under the mind frame, the browser only renders it, and verify recomputes every pose.
Mind frames are signed with the heartbeat's key, so each one proves which mind wrote it.

amended_because.what: Dreams are canon and held: each night the one mind folds the day into one frame on dream:@kody-w/ainexus, the morning after quotes it word for word, and every mind frame reads the newest dream as its memory instead of the day.
